title: Deterministic Weighted Loot Table
description: Create a weighted loot table supporting rarity weights, quantity ranges, guaranteed drops, and deterministic seeded rolls.
requirements: Zero-weight entries must never be selected randomly.
Invalid or empty tables must return a descriptive failure.
Guaranteed drops must be resolved separately from weighted drops.
The same seed and input data must produce the same result.
Random number generation must be supplied as a dependency.
constraint: Invalid input must be handled without throwing from the public gameplay API.
stretchGoal: Support runtime configuration changes without rebuilding the entire system.
